body.value:
PT_501(
    PV_High := 85.0,
    PV_Low := 65.0,
    Scaling_Slope := 9.375,
    Scaling_Offset := -37.5);
LI_502(
    PV_High := 90.0,
    PV_Low := 5.0,
    Scaling_Slope := 6.25,
    Scaling_Offset := -25.0);
SeparatorShutdown_OR := PT_501.General_Fault OR PIC_501.PV_High_Alarm;
FV_102(
    Control_Signal := PIC_501.XOUT,
    Manual_Mode := FALSE,
    Open_Limit := 100.0,
    Close_Limit := 0.0,
    Inhibit := SeparatorShutdown_OR);
PIC501_Inhibit_OR := SeparatorShutdown_OR OR PT_501.High_Alarm OR PT_501.Low_Alarm OR LI_502.Low_Alarm OR LI_502.High_Alarm OR FV_102.Alarm;
PIC_501(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    PV := PT_501.PV,
    SP := 75.0,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    X0 := FV_102.Feedback_Pos,
    KP := 2.0,
    TR := 0.5,
    TD := 0.1,
    Inhibit := PIC501_Inhibit_OR);

(* Outputs published to other sections / HMI. *)
PT501_Pressure_PV := PT_501.PV;
LI502_Level_PV := LI_502.PV;
PIC501_Output_To_FV102 := PIC_501.XOUT;

FT_105(
    PV_High := 45.0,
    PV_Low := 5.0,
    Scaling_Slope := 3.125,
    Scaling_Offset := -12.5,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
LI_503(
    PV_High := 90.0,
    PV_Low := 10.0,
    Scaling_Slope := 6.25,
    Scaling_Offset := -25.0,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
P_001();
PumpNotRunning := NOT P_001.FB_Running;
FlowOverride := FT_105.Low_Alarm OR FT_105.High_Alarm OR PumpNotRunning OR FT_105.General_Fault;
LIC_502(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    PV := FT_105.PV,
    SP := 35.0,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    KP := 1.8,
    TR := 2.0,
    TD := 0.0,
    Inhibit := FlowOverride);
LevelOverride := LI_503.High_Alarm OR LI_503.Low_Alarm OR PumpNotRunning OR LI_503.General_Fault;
LIC_503(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    PV := LI_503.PV,
    SP := 65.0,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    KP := -2.0,
    TR := 1.5,
    TD := 0.1,
    Inhibit := LevelOverride);
LVC_502(
    Control_Signal := LIC_502.XOUT,
    Manual_Mode := FlowOverride,
    Manual_Position := 100.0,
    Open_Limit := 100.0,
    Close_Limit := 0.0,
    Inhibit := FlowOverride);
LVC_507(
    Control_Signal := LIC_503.XOUT,
    Manual_Mode := LevelOverride,
    Manual_Position := 0.0,
    Open_Limit := 100.0,
    Close_Limit := 0.0,
    Inhibit := LevelOverride);

(* Outputs published to other sections / HMI. *)
FT105_FlowRate_gpm := FT_105.PV;
LI503_Level_Pct := LI_503.PV;
P001_Running_Permissive := P_001.FB_Running;

(* Entry point required by OpenPLC Editor v4. The process sections run as parallel program instances under task0; main only provides a scan heartbeat. *)
Heartbeat := NOT Heartbeat;
